tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: One-call verdict for an ERC-20 on Base: runs token risk (incl. holder concentration), rug-pull and momentum checks plus contract flags (proxy, blacklist, pause, selfdestruct, own on-chain sell simulation) and returns avoid / high_risk / caution / low_risk with a one-line English summary. Use once be

tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: Risk score 0-100 (higher = riskier) for an ERC-20 on Base: derived liquidity view, holder concentration, sell-blocked/tax flags from our own on-chain sell simulation. Use before buying or listing an unknown Base token. $0.01 via x402. Not investment advice.

tools.name: rug_check
tools.description: Rug-pull check for an ERC-20 on Base: rug_pull true/false, confidence and 5 signals (liquidity removal, wash trading, LP lock, owner wallet, sell tax from our own sell simulation). Use before buying a new Base token. $0.02 via x402.

tools.name: holder_check
tools.description: PAUSED: holder_check answers paused without asking for payment and is never charged (its top-holder source was a third-party API we no longer use). For holder concentration use token_risk (holder_concentration).

tools.name: momentum_score
tools.description: Momentum score 0-100 for an ERC-20 on Base from 24 h volume, volume vs liquidity and price change, with confidence low/medium/high. Null for stablecoins. Use to rank Base tokens by activity. $0.02 via x402.
